label: 17 November 2026
title: Cubarsí doubt for Villarreal with psoas overload; De Jong available; Olmo back in group
deck: Barcelona issued medical updates on Monday. Pau Cubarsí has an iliopsoas overload and is a doubt for the 22 November home game against Villarreal. Frenkie de Jong has an obturator stretch but will be available. Dani Olmo completed part of the group session on his return to training.

stories.headline: Cubarsí has iliopsoas overload and is a doubt for Villarreal
stories.summary: Pau Cubarsí returned from Spain with an overload in the iliopsoas muscle. The club said his evolution will decide whether he is available for the Villarreal match on Sunday 22 November at Spotify Camp Nou. He was substituted at half-time in the Nations League defeat to England.
stories.body: Luis de la Fuente took the centre-back off after 45 minutes against England at the Metropolitano. Barcelona’s medical staff confirmed the diagnosis on Monday morning at the Ciutat Esportiva. No fixed return date has been given. If he misses Villarreal, the next opportunities are the Champions League trip to Sabah on 25 November or the visit to Deportivo on 29 November. Cubarsí had been one of the more available senior defenders through the early part of the season.

tweets.text: 📝 COMUNICADO MÉDICO El jugador del primer equipo Pau Cubarsí tiene una sobrecarga en el músculo psoas ilíaco. Su evolución marcará la disponibilidad para el partido contra el Villarreal.

stories.headline: De Jong has obturator stretch but is available for Villarreal
stories.summary: Frenkie de Jong has a stretch in the obturator muscle. Barcelona confirmed he will be available for the Villarreal game. He left the Netherlands camp early and missed the Nations League match against Germany.
stories.body: Xavi Hernández had already ruled him out of the Berlin fixture after he reported discomfort. The Dutch federation and Barcelona’s medical staff both ran tests. The club’s statement on Monday said he is available for Sunday. He is expected to start on the bench and be managed carefully after the international window. De Jong had returned from a knee issue earlier in the campaign and had been used in several midfield and defensive roles.

tweets.text: 📝 COMUNICADO MÉDICO El jugador del primer equipo Frenkie de Jong tiene un estiramiento en el músculo obturador. Estará disponible para el partido contra el Villarreal.

stories.headline: Olmo completes part of the group session on return to training
stories.summary: Dani Olmo worked with the group for part of Monday’s session at the Ciutat Esportiva. He had been out since the PSG match and is aiming for the Villarreal game on 22 November.
stories.body: Olmo missed the Atlético fixture and the international window while recovering. Reports from the training ground on Monday said he completed a portion of the collective work. The rest of the available squad also returned after the break. Hansi Flick has a full week to prepare before Villarreal visit Spotify Camp Nou at 14:00 on Sunday.

tweets.name: Barça World
tweets.text: Injury boost: Dani Olmo back to group training ahead of weekend game against Villarreal.

stories.headline: Squad back at the Ciutat Esportiva for the week ahead of Villarreal
stories.summary: Barcelona’s players returned to training on Monday after the international break. The club posted images from the session with the message that this is a week to get ready.
stories.body: Most of the internationals have landed or are expected back in the coming days. Raphinha remains with Brazil in Singapore for the friendly against the hosts. The medical staff continue to monitor Cubarsí. Flick has time to assess the group before naming a squad for the Sunday fixture. Training will continue through the week at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper.

stories.headline: Villarreal, Sabah and Deportivo close the month
stories.summary: Barcelona face Villarreal at home on Sunday 22 November (14:00), travel to Sabah in the Champions League on Wednesday 25 November, and visit Deportivo on Sunday 29 November.
stories.body: Mundo Deportivo noted that Barcelona have won only 54.5% of matches after the November international break in recent seasons. The side go into the period having recovered form with the 6-1 win over Alavés, the 3-0 against Aston Villa and the comeback at Atlético. The remaining home games at Spotify Camp Nou before the end of 2026 also include Atlético, Manchester City, Celta and Real Sociedad.

stories.headline: Options at centre-back if Cubarsí misses Villarreal
stories.summary: If Cubarsí is unavailable, Flick’s centre-back options include Eric García, Andreas Christensen and possibly De Jong. Koundé and Espart remain out.
stories.body: Eric García has been used at right-back in recent weeks with the senior full-backs unavailable. Christensen returned to the group before the break. De Jong played centre-back against Alavés. Gerard Martín has been a regular in the back line. The medical updates on Monday leave the starting pair for Sunday still to be decided once Cubarsí’s progress through the week is clearer.

tweets.name: Barça Buzz
tweets.text: If Cubarsí doesn't make it against Villarreal on Sunday, Flick's options at centre-back are: Eric García, Christensen, or Frenkie de Jong.

stories.headline: Raphinha remains with Brazil for the Singapore friendly
stories.summary: Raphinha stays with the Brazil squad in Singapore for Tuesday’s friendly against the hosts. He was sent off against Japan and is suspended for that match but the CBF did not release him early.
stories.body: Rodrigo Caetano confirmed after the Japan game that Raphinha would complete the trip. The Barcelona captain had spoken with Ancelotti about managing his minutes after signing a new deal until 2030. He is expected back in Barcelona next week and available for Villarreal if there are no further issues. The club and CBF had already agreed to control his workload during this window.

stories.headline: Van Asten’s late header earns Femení a point at Riazor
stories.summary: Barcelona Femení drew 1-1 at Deportivo Abanca. Vega put the hosts ahead after the break. Renée van Asten equalised in the 101st minute.
stories.body: Pere Romeu made several changes from the Champions League draw with Arsenal. The first half finished 0-0. Deportivo scored on the counter shortly after the restart. Van Asten, introduced at half-time, headed in from Patri’s cross after a lengthy VAR check. It was the side’s second draw in a week. Barcelona remain four points clear at the top of Liga F.
